2893-4500-4762-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4500-4762-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Retreat to Kazandu and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4500-4762-8289.notes: Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.

277-1021-1669-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4875-5147-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5147-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-2198-2527-5294-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-5294-6798.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1420-2178-2921.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-2921.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-6634.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1003-2626-4986-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4499-4549-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate the Shards by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Niko, adding {1}.
Repeat.

140-3245-5174.description:
Activate Immolating Souleater by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

280-1558-2638-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-2638-4231-6753.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1824-2530-2906-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2906-7349.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-2906-7349.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2981-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2981-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2981-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4242-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

57-969-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-969-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-3490-4050-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-4476.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3967-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

821-883-2173-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3446-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3446-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student // Tamiyo, Seasoned Scholar

708-2500-4050-6223.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-413-527-5223.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

186-4613-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
186-4613-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1737-2793-2981.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat each turn.

225-5411-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
225-5411-5720-5721.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for the remaining triggers.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1329-1636-1778-2034.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-1778-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
